text.reference: 兵士：ココヲ通レバ近道ダ。マタ来イヨ。
text.translation: Soldier: This way is a shortcut. Come again.

text.reference: IDカードガ無ケレバ通レナイ
オトナシクヒキ返サナイト撃ツゾ！
text.translation: TURN BACK QUIETLY OR I'LL SHOOT!

text.reference: IDカードヲ持ッテイルノカ？
フフフッ、ヨクデキテイルナ。{n}大佐ノ客ダナ、通ッテイイゾ。
text.translation: Heh heh, very well made.{n}You're the Colonel's guest. You may pass.

text.reference: 兵士：おまえハ、悪魔と戦っているのカ？{n}大佐かラ、強力な武器を手に入れたカ。
text.translation: Soldier: You fight demons?{n}Did the Colonel give you powerful weapons?

text.reference: 大佐も商売上手だナ、悪魔と戦う者のためと{n}言っテ、武器庫の物を売ってもうけていル。
text.translation: The Colonel is quite the businessman.{n}He claims it's for demon fighters, but sells depot weapons for profit.

text.reference: 本当ニ、悪魔と戦う物のためなラ、{n}金を取るかイ？武器庫の物ハ、大佐の物じゃ{n}ないんダ。
text.translation: If it were really for those fighting demons,{n}would he charge money? Those weapons{n}don't belong to him.
